monsters.name: Coalspindle
monsters.premise: A soot-and-wicker creature born from the ritual of banking a hearth before sleep; it runs on jointed firewood legs.

monsters.name: Hearthmoth
monsters.premise: A folded festival-paper creature whose ember-patterned wings glow with wishes left beside household fires.

monsters.name: Ribbonrook
monsters.premise: A road-sign ribbon given a birdlike body by travelers' farewell songs; its trailing knots point toward home.

monsters.name: Chimekite
monsters.premise: A living weather kite with a ring of floating ceramic chimes, awakened by a town's first spring procession.

monsters.name: Cairnox
monsters.premise: A moving cairn with branch antlers, born when generations add stones to mark a safe mountain crossing.

monsters.name: Rootwrit
monsters.premise: A root-bound clay figure carrying leaf-shaped tablets, formed from vows buried beneath an old boundary tree.

monsters.name: Rillhorn
monsters.premise: A stream creature with a curved hollow horn and stepping-stone feet, born from the promise to keep a ford open.

monsters.name: Wellwisp
monsters.premise: A suspended bead of water inside a walking rope-and-bucket frame, awakened by wishes spoken into a village well.

monsters.name: Knellbadger
monsters.premise: A squat burrowing creature with a silent bell-shaped carapace, born from the solemn counting of names at dusk.

monsters.name: Duskquill
monsters.premise: An ink-bodied creature with floating quills for limbs, formed from unfinished stories hidden away at night.

monsters.name: Bellmane
monsters.premise: A four-legged lantern guardian with a mane of luminous bell ribbons, born from a community's vow to guide lost travelers.

monsters.name: Glimmerscribe
monsters.premise: A walking bundle of translucent scrolls with a hovering lamp for a head, awakened by records of promises kept.

sets.name: Ember Pursuit
sets.plan: Three attacks offer normal-speed damage, finishing, and limited Air coverage; clear disruptive effects.

sets.name: Vow of Sparks
sets.plan: Prepare an attacking window or use Fray to pressure a durable switch-in.

sets.name: Hearthkeeper
sets.plan: Recover after favorable exchanges; Water coverage improves attacks into Earth.

sets.name: Ash Courier
sets.plan: Use Fray and slower opposing Speed to create a later attacking opportunity.

sets.name: Road Scout
sets.plan: Act first at normal priority and remove disruption; Fire coverage helps against Dark.

sets.name: Tailwind Vow
sets.plan: Trade a preparation action for stronger attacks; retain two finishing types.

sets.name: High Chime
sets.plan: Create a Spirit attacking window while retaining an answer to opposing boosts and statuses.

sets.name: Crosscurrent
sets.plan: Pressure switches and slow faster threats; Light coverage helps against Dark.

sets.name: Stone Shelter
sets.plan: Use finite bracing to buy time for Fray and core damage; Fire coverage helps against Dark.

sets.name: Patient Bell
sets.plan: Slow moderate-speed opponents, clear disruption, and use Air coverage against Water.

sets.name: Binding Script
sets.plan: Change later move order and remove disruption; Light coverage helps against Dark.

sets.name: Holding Ground
sets.plan: Brace while applying pressure; choose Force against opponents whose Guard is sufficiently lower than Ward.

sets.name: Ford Runner
sets.plan: Control later Speed and attack through the more useful type; Fire coverage helps against Air.

sets.name: Rising Horn
sets.plan: Prepare stronger attacks or punish a durable switch; Air coverage helps against Light.

sets.name: Wellkeeper
sets.plan: Take favorable exchanges, spend bounded recovery, and finish with matching-type priority.

sets.name: Eroding Mark
sets.plan: Apply pressure or change Speed; Earth coverage helps against Light.

sets.name: Toll Collector
sets.plan: Use high Guard to stay active while pressuring Health; clear status or setup threats.

sets.name: Closed Gate
sets.plan: Buy a finite defensive window and slow opponents enough to threaten an earlier knockout.

sets.name: Night Courier
sets.plan: Use fast Spirit damage with cleanup; Earth coverage helps against both Fire and Light.

sets.name: Ink Oath
sets.plan: Prepare an attacking window or pressure a switch; lacks immediate cleanup.

sets.name: Open Bell
sets.plan: Select the damage category that deals more damage, then finish or remove disruption.

sets.name: Ringing Vow
sets.plan: Prepare both damage categories and exploit whichever defense is lower.

sets.name: Ward Script
sets.plan: Use high Ward and finite bracing while Fray advances the battle; Water coverage helps against Earth.

sets.name: Clear Script
sets.plan: Slow moderate-speed threats, clear disruption, and finish with matching-type priority.
